description: Validation of components (APPLICATIONS.md §5.10.1) and modals (§5.10.3), plus encrypted component and modal values. Each case of `validation` has an `input` with either `components` (the value of the `components` field of a text content object) or `modal` (the `modal` of a modal response); `expected` is null for valid input, else the error `code` and `meta.path` of the first offending field. Binary values are base64url without padding; keys and devices are those of encryption.json (content, device_attestation).
